mutant.description: Negative controls run per rule and per arm, each aimed at the specific field or half under test rather than at the artifact generally. (a) substrate-card-check: mutating /artifact/persistence/mutation_policy to a non-enum value. (b) refuse_prose_enum_mismatch: run against the known-defective pre-repair pin. (c) refuse_unscoped_lifetime_claim: run against BOTH stopped pins before repair, and against three known-clean cards. (d) the KeyCount probe: a nonexistent bucket, aimed at the PROJECTION half specifically after an earlier version left that half rc-blind while the full-response half was already fail-closed. (e) is-ancestor: the reversed proposition on every containment read.
mutant.expected: each control fires on its own subject and stays quiet on a known-good one
mutant.observed: (a) violations=1 INVALID rc=1 naming the exact field; later bidirectional -- mutating the field also fires RULE 2 in reverse. (b) FIRES on 4a5e165fbf naming mutation_policy; PASSES after repair; CLEAN on 4 of 4 certified cards after a basis/value branch was added -- its FIRST version fired on a certified card and the card was correct, so the arm was fixed rather than the card reported. (c) FIRES on 4 distinct paths at EACH of 0db07bb687 and 19f0a0d69f; 0 on both successors; CLEAN on cse, code_heat_snap, fedobs_coevolution_snap. A second, DIFFERENT predicate (sentence-scoped rather than character-proximity) agreed on all 8 pre-repair carriers and 0 on both successors. (d) RAISES rc=255 NoSuchBucket at the projection half; the full-response half raises on rc!=0 or unparseable body; positive contrast on the real prefix returns '0'/True versus 'None'/False. (e) reversed is-ancestor correctly FAILS on every containment read taken.
